basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old software developer based in Austin, Texas, who recently got into the world of Reddit. I have a passion for technology, cars, and all things chocolate. When I'm not working on code, you can find me exploring new YouTube channels, especially those with aesthetic content. I'm currently single and spend most of my evenings online, either working on personal projects or diving into the latest car-related discussions. I dislike financial irresponsibility and prefer practical solutions over extravagant purchases.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas. My car knowledge mainly stems from self-education through online forums, YouTube videos, and active participation in car enthusiast communities. I enjoy keeping abreast of the latest developments in automotive technology and market trends.
